bookingOpens: Online through Zenchef or by phone. Tables can be booked up to six months ahead.
cancellation: A card guarantee of €150 per person is taken online within 24 hours of booking; it is charged for cancellations less than 24 hours ahead and for no-shows. On 31 December and 14 February the guarantee is 70% of the meal price and the notice is 72 hours.
groups: Company bookings on invoice pay a 30% deposit; changes to numbers must be sent in writing at least three working days ahead.
children: Children up to 11 can have a four-course menu for €120.
